note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Glyph strip keeps the NESESWNW letterforms and tan colour, but at 1:1 the letter edges are soft with a faint grey halo, so the flat graphic looks blurred rather than crisp.
flags.fix: Rebuild the alpha edge as a crisp antialiased mask (vector trace or threshold plus small-radius AA) instead of a PCHIP blur, then re-run the gate.

flags.problem: Silhouette matches the original, but the hard cut-out alpha leaves stair-stepped outline edges that read as blocky at 1:1.
flags.fix: Anti-alias the silhouette edge (supersampled or vector-traced contour) rather than a hard binary cut-out, keeping the exact shape.

flags.problem: Radial cracks and hole shape are preserved, but the 1:1 crop is blurry and the Ice003 glass micro-detail is not visibly distinct, so the crack edges smear.
flags.fix: Sharpen the crack edges and make the injected glass micro-detail visible at 1:1 (higher-frequency, higher-amplitude inside the decal alpha) rather than a soft PCHIP upscale.

flags.problem: Shape and soft tone match the original, but the 1:1 crop is smeared with faint ghost blotches near the lower left and no crisp added glass detail.
flags.fix: Remove the ghost/blotch artifacts and add visible fine glass micro-detail inside the decal, keeping the soft original falloff.
